ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels and 30% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central region; dense black mottling along the left-of-center leading edge; distinctive curvilinear black squiggle pattern in the lower-right quadrant; several vertical black linear streaks localized at the upper trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 35 degrees; depth is significant but partially interrupted by secondary jagged indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular amplitude serrations; sharp peaks and valleys are most pronounced on the right lobe; several major notches exceed 15 pixels in depth relative to the linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe exhibits a strong convex sweep transitioning into a pointed tip, though the trajectory is highly fragmented by acquired edge loss.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-intensity white pixel groups (barnacles) localized along the entire visible trailing edge, with a major concentration (approx. 15-20 units) at the right lobe terminus.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned vertical black linear disruptions extending from the upper trailing edge into the white pigmentation field; horizontal scratches visible near the right-central fluke body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep, jagged avulsion or traumatic notch on the inner right lobe adjacent to the median notch; significant tissue loss on the trailing edge yielding a highly irregular silhouette.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique bulbous cluster of barnacles on the extreme right tip which alters the standard geometric profile of the fluke lobe.
